data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001's own stated target IDs are SRC_001 and SRC_002, yet the target under audit is listed as only SRC_001. More substantively, the artifact's entire argument rests on analyzing 'mechanist and skeptic school policies (SRC_001, SRC_002)' — but with commitments listed as '(none)', there is no actual policy content provided for either source. The artifact asserts these policies 'implicitly converge on falsificationist principles,' but this convergence is asserted, not demonstrated from any available evidence. Without committed policy content to audit, the central claim about cross-school convergence is ungrounded — the artifact is adjudicating a structural relationship between documents whose substance is absent from the audit record. This fails §11.3's sustained-flag standard because the flag rests on a premise the target cannot substantiate from its own commitments.
